name: Togo
description: Togo from its kingdoms to German Togoland, French rule, independence in 1960 and the Gnassingbé family.

checkpoints.name: German Togoland
checkpoints.note: Germany made Togoland a colony in 1884.

checkpoints.name: French Togo
checkpoints.note: Britain and France split the colony; the French part became Togo.

checkpoints.name: Independent Togo
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1960. Olympio was killed in 1963, and the Gnassingbé family has ruled since 1967.

audio.title: Salut à toi, pays de nos aïeux
